text: Welcome.
Let this morning begin with a little gratitude.
Take a few moments… to acknowledge the part of you that brought you here today.
Feel the support beneath your body.
Let your breathing find an easy rhythm.
You might let your shoulders soften.
Bring to mind one small thing you appreciate.
Perhaps a familiar face, a warm drink, or the light in the room.
Let it be something simple. Whatever feels real to you today.
Notice what happens in your body as you hold that thought.
Allow whatever you notice to be enough.
Let that small moment have a little more room.
You might offer yourself the same kindness.
Consider one small way to carry this into your morning.
Begin to notice the room around you.
Gently move your fingers and toes.
Let your eyes open at your own pace.
Welcome back.
You can return to this practice whenever you like.
If you like, carry this little moment of gratitude into your day.
